title: NormalizedRecord
description: Execution Plan section 3.1. Produced by A1 ingest+normalize. This is the single source of truth for the shape; pydantic and TypeScript types are generated from this file, never hand-edited.

work_id.description: Unique identifier for the work. Fatal if missing (eng review Success Criteria table).

state.description: Fatal if missing: no peer group, no filtering.

implementing_agency.description: Degradable for the table, fatal for the fund-flow graph (M5).

vendor_name.description: Degradable for the table, fatal for the fund-flow graph (M5). Least likely field to be publicly exposed.

work_category.description: Fatal if missing: no category means no peer group, and peer group is mandatory on every flagged record.

sanctioned_amount_inr.description: Fatal if missing: the cost-outlier detector is the primary flag.

expenditure_amount_inr.description: Degradable: loses the expenditure-mismatch flag, keeps the rest.

sanction_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null. Degradable: needed for stalled-work detection.

source_rung.description: Which acquisition rung produced this record. See Execution Plan section 2.
